content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for NIT Silchar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the current recruitment drive by NIT Silchar is Junior Research Fellow. This is a contractual government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in the National Institute of Technology Silchar recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application for the Junior Research Fellow post is 31 August 2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Silchar is Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (Specialization in Machine Design, Materials and Manufacturing)/Biomedical Engineering or related fields with minimum 60% marks and be GATE/NET qualified.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow post will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Silchar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Silchar will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow post will be Silchar, Assam, as the National Institute of Technology Silchar is located there.
